start_here: Say to your AI: "Read the Claude Code run I saved in run.jsonl as events and tell me which tools it started and what it replied." It runs the reader on your computer and lists one event per line.
no_lists_because: It only reads a saved run stream from a file and prints events; it keeps no list of yours.
instructions: 1. Save the run's JSON stream to a file, for example claude -p "..." --output-format stream-json --verbose > run.jsonl (Codex: codex exec --json).

2. Say "Read run.jsonl as events from claude-code". The AI reads the row with tools:list and runs node tools/follow-my-ai-command-line-runs/do-work/follow-runs.mjs --events claude-code < run.jsonl from the Workshop checkout.
3. Read the output, one JSON event per line: kind is thinking, text, tool_start, tool_done or reply. Lines that are not JSON or match no row are ignored.
4. An unknown command line id exits 2 and prints {"error": "No command line ... Known: codex, claude-code."} on standard error; use one of the ids it lists.

worked_examples.title: A four-line Claude Code run becomes five events
worked_examples.ask: Read run.jsonl as events from claude-code.
worked_examples.given: From tools/follow-my-ai-command-line-runs/test/session-runs.test.mjs ("each CLI's own stream lines become the same normalised events"). Command: node tools/follow-my-ai-command-line-runs/do-work/follow-runs.mjs --events claude-code < run.jsonl, where run.jsonl holds these lines: {"type":"system","subtype":"init"} {"type":"assistant","message":{"content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"plan it"},{"type":"text","text":"Looking."},{"type":"tool_use","id":"t1","name":"Read"}]}} {"type":"user","message":{"content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"t1"}]}} {"type":"result","result":"All done."} followed by a line "not json".
worked_examples.hands_back: {"kind":"thinking","text":"plan it"} {"kind":"text","text":"Looking."} {"kind":"tool_start","name":"Read","id":"t1"} {"kind":"tool_done","id":"t1"} {"kind":"reply","text":"All done."} (one per line; the init line and the "not json" line print nothing; the last line is the reply event).
